description: Phase 1 critical fixes: enforce role-based auth on all 5 API routers, fix requirements.txt, fix ML forecast determinism, fix CVRP load_utilization_pct, fix DriverPage arrival times, and update AuthContext + api.js for token expiry and 401 interception.
steps: 1. Verify backend/requirements.txt has python-jose[cryptography]>=3.3.0, passlib[bcrypt]>=1.7.4, httpx>=0.27.0, pytest>=8.0.0, pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0 — all confirmed present in existing file; no changes needed.

2. Add auth dependencies to backend/app/api/routes/nodes.py: import get_current_user_token, require_role, TokenData from app.core.security. GET / and GET /{node_id} and POST /{node_id}/collect → Depends(get_current_user_token). POST / and PUT /{node_id} and DELETE /{node_id} → Depends(require_role('manager','admin')). POST /{node_id}/report stays PUBLIC (no dependency).

3. Add auth dependencies to backend/app/api/routes/forecast.py: import require_role, get_current_user_token, TokenData from app.core.security. POST / and GET /daily → Depends(require_role('manager','admin')). Leave GET /weather as a placeholder comment for FEAT-003.

4. Add auth dependencies to backend/app/api/routes/routing.py: import get_current_user_token, require_role, TokenData from app.core.security. POST /optimize, GET /today, POST /dispatch, GET /history → Depends(require_role('manager','admin')). POST /stop/status → Depends(require_role('driver','manager','admin')).

5. Add auth dependencies to backend/app/api/routes/fleet.py: import get_current_user_token, require_role, TokenData from app.core.security, and add logging. GET / → Depends(require_role('manager','admin','driver')). POST /, PATCH /{truck_id}, DELETE /{truck_id} → Depends(require_role('manager','admin')).
6. Add auth dependencies to backend/app/api/routes/analytics.py: import require_role from app.core.security. GET /summary → Depends(require_role('manager','admin')).

7. Fix backend/app/ml/forecaster.py: replace 'confidence = round(random.uniform(0.75, 0.90), 3)' with 'confidence = round(0.75 + (seed % 1000) / 1000 * 0.15, 3)'. Remove 'import random' from the imports section (verify no other usage in the file — there is none).

8. Fix backend/app/routing/cvrp_solver.py: add 'truck_capacity_kg: int = 5000' parameter to _calculate_route(). Replace hardcoded '5000' in load_utilization_pct calculation with the parameter. Update the _calculate_route() call inside optimize_routes() to pass truck_capacity_kg=truck_capacity_kg. Remove the now-redundant overwrite line 'route["load_utilization_pct"] = round(route["total_waste_kg"] / truck_capacity_kg * 100, 1)' that follows the call.

9. Fix frontend/src/pages/DriverPage.jsx: find the hardcoded arrival time formula '0{8 + Math.floor(idx * 0.8)}:{idx % 2 === 0 ? "15" : "45"} AM' and replace with '{stop.estimated_arrival || `${String(8 + Math.floor(idx * 0.8)).padStart(2,"0")}:${idx % 2 === 0 ? "15" : "45"}`}'.

10. Update frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx: (a) Add isTokenExpired(token) helper function that base64-decodes the JWT payload and checks exp*1000 < Date.now(). (b) In the useEffect localStorage restore block, call isTokenExpired() and clear storage + skip restore if token is expired. (c) In login() callback, normalize userData by adding 'name: data.user.full_name || data.user.name' to fix Navbar initials display. (d) Optionally expose isTokenExpired in context value.
11. Update frontend/src/services/api.js: add response interceptor after the request interceptor that redirects to '/login' on 401 and to '/unauthorized' on 403, clearing localStorage on 401.
acceptance_criteria: Two calls to _heuristic_forecast for same node+date return identical confidence values
optimize_routes with truck_capacity_kg=3000 and 2000kg load returns load_utilization_pct ~66.7
cd frontend && npm run build completes without errors
cd backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print("OK")' runs without ImportError
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.api.routes.nodes import router; print([r.dependencies for r in router.routes])"

cd backend && python -c "from app.ml.forecaster import _heuristic_forecast; from datetime import date; r1=_heuristic_forecast({'node_id':'N1','capacity_kg':500},date(2026,10,1)); r2=_heuristic_forecast({'node_id':'N1','capacity_kg':500},date(2026,10,1)); assert r1[1]==r2[1],'Not deterministic'; print('PASS confidence=',r1[1])"

cd backend && python -c "from app.routing.cvrp_solver import optimize_routes; r=optimize_routes([{'node_id':'N1','node_name':'T','latitude':28.55,'longitude':77.25,'predicted_volume_kg':2000,'fill_percentage':60,'risk_level':'medium'}],num_trucks=1,truck_capacity_kg=3000); print('util=',r['routes'][0]['load_utilization_pct']); assert abs(r['routes'][0]['load_utilization_pct']-66.7)<1"
findings: 1. Python 3.14 + FastAPI: Optional[X] = Depends(None) is not valid — login route in auth.py was changed to accept only JSON body (UserLogin), dropping OAuth2 form-data support. Frontend uses JSON login so behavior is unchanged. Later FEATs should not add Depends(None) patterns. 2. bcrypt>=4.1.2 is incompatible with passlib 1.7.x (__about__ attribute removed). Pinned bcrypt==4.0.1 in requirements.txt — do not upgrade without also upgrading passlib or switching to bcrypt directly. 3. Python hash() is PYTHONHASHSEED-randomized — the heuristic confidence value varies between separate process invocations but is stable within a single process (same-call determinism holds). If cross-process determinism is needed, switch seed to use hashlib. 4. All 5 routers now require auth using function-parameter Depends pattern (not router-level dependencies=[]). Tests in tests/ were updated to use an admin_token fixture — all 21 tests pass. 5. Routing endpoints (optimize, today, dispatch, history) require manager/admin. stop/status requires driver/manager/admin. DriverPage in the frontend currently calls /routing/optimize without auth — it will 401 until a driver token is injected via the AuthContext (FEAT-002 or later should ensure DriverPage passes the token).
